room_rent.note: SI 3L–7.5L: Single Private AC room. SI 10L and above: any room category. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: Actual ICU expenses paid as provided by hospital.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Zone B: 15% if treated in Zone A; Zone C: 20% in Zone A, 5% in Zone B. Voluntary 10%/20% co-pay option available.

sub_limits.display: Cataract 20% of SI/eye (max ₹1L); Bariatric 50% of SI (max ₹5L); Maternity sub-limits
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI per eye, max ₹1,00,000. Bariatric: 50% of SI, max ₹5L. Maternity: Normal ₹15K/₹25K, Caesarean ₹25K/₹35K depending on SI band.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹50,000/₹1,00,000/₹2,00,000/₹3,00,000 available as optional cost-sharing.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents. Not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Reduced to extent of prior continuous coverage under portability norms.

specific_disease_waiting.note: List of 27 conditions including cataract, hernia, piles, stones, etc. Also 36-month wait for joint replacement, vertebral surgery, bariatric, Parkinson's, genetic disorders, etc.

maternity.note: Max 2 deliveries/terminations. Normal delivery ₹15K (SI ≤7.5L)/₹25K (SI >7.5L); Caesarean ₹25K/₹35K. Pre/post-natal hospitalisation (90 days post-delivery) within maternity limit. Newborn covered within maternity SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year; max 100% of base SI. Reduced by 10% in year after a claim.

restoration.note: Triggered only after full SI (including CB) is exhausted. Cancer/Kidney Failure: once in lifetime; other conditions: every year.

day_care.display: Listed procedures (399+ listed in Annexure I)

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in policy wording.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation Treatment SI.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹20,000 per policy year. Air ambulance available as optional add-on for SI ≥5L.

modern_treatments.note: Annexure III list including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: No global cover; no domiciliary; non-medical consumables excluded; maternity 72-month wait; treatment outside India excluded
optional_riders: Air Ambulance (SI ≥5L); Voluntary co-pay (10%/20%); Voluntary aggregate deductible (₹50K–₹3L); Room rent cap discount option
